name: Editor UX Layout And Graph Navigation
description: The primary working screen MUST be divided into four resizable regions: left sidebar (default 20% width), right sidebar (default 20% width), bottom panel (default 20% height), and a top-center panel filling remaining space. The left sidebar MUST provide VS Code-like navigation including search, pinned, and recent items, with a primary tree rooted at the Mission and showing cards as `ID: Name`. The top-center panel MUST provide a centered graph view where selecting a card centers it, parents appear above, descendants below, siblings left/right (siblings ordered lexicographically by Card ID), and keyboard navigation is supported.
